verdict_one_line: Construction is genuinely novel (distinct from INV09, monthly-median Spearman -0.33 < 0.5 target) but the long-only top-N tradeable leg fails decisively (PORT_t -1.28, rank-IC -0.031 Harvey-t -5.38). The real signal is INVERTED and SHORT-LEG/CONTRARIAN-only: sustained smart-money BUY streaks underperform; SELL streaks subsequently rebound (bottom-20 gross active SR 0.45, t 2.09). KR no-short cannot harvest it. Hypothesized execution-program continuation mechanism is rejected by the data (mean-reversion, not momentum). Screen-route only.

factor_specs.formula: smart_t = Foreign_t + Institutional_t (daily net-buy KRW); s_t = sign(smart_t) with |smart_t|<1e8 KRW => 0 (noise floor); RunLen_t = signed consecutive same-sign streak ending at t (zero day breaks streak), clipped to [-10,+10]; MAG_RUN score = RunLen_t * (AvgAbsFlowInRun / Size_{t-1}); cross-section winsor(1,99) + z-score per sig_date (C13 Z_Score_Aligned).
factor_specs.lag_rule: investor flow Date < sig_date strict (C2, T+1 lag); Size t-1 latest; ADV t-1 20d
factor_specs.economic_rationale: HYPOTHESIZED (and REJECTED by data): a sustained one-directional informed (Foreign+Institutional) net-buy streak proxies a multi-day execution PROGRAM not completable in one day due to market impact, predicting continued same-direction pressure. NON-return-derived (flow identity), distinct from INV09 sign-count fraction which is blind to consecutiveness (10 alternating days = INV09 0.5 but RunLen ~1). EMPIRICAL FINDING: the forward relation is the OPPOSITE of continuation -- long buy-streaks mean-revert (rank-IC -0.031, t -5.38); the harvestable content is contrarian on sell-streaks (un-shortable in KR).

honest_reporting.ax000_amended: A clean, faithfully-reported negative IS success. M36 is one data point in the ongoing momentum-hunt campaign; this is NOT a structural limit. The campaign finding sharpens: flow LEVEL (C21/C22) had no edge; flow STRUCTURE (M36 run-length) has a real but INVERTED + un-harvestable edge. Distinctness from INV09 was proven (the novelty test passed) -- but distinctness did not translate to a tradeable long-only alpha. Mechanism learning: KR smart-money buy-streaks mean-revert at the 1M horizon (consistent with Daniel-Moskowitz momentum-crash/reversal intuition on the buying side), they do not continue.
